findings: l.2361 'the proof of this Lemma is not different from the proof of the similar statement for Lorentzian manifolds' (i.e. M GH => M~ GH => M~ future distinguishing): with T_BTZ (DEC-77 (b)) the middle step is FALSE. The model J+(Delta_0) = E0~ with T_BTZ is not globally hyperbolic (GX.btzJ0Tilde_not_globallyHyperbolic, GX.btzJ0_not_globallyHyperbolic): in null coordinates the diamond J+(p0) cap J-(q), p0 = 0 (BTZ point), q = (2,1,0), contains x_eps = (1, eps^2, eps), on the null cone of p0, which tend in Minkowski space to the BTZ point x = (1,0,0) but never enter its BTZ neighbourhood I+(p) cup ]p,+inf[, p = (1/2,0,0); no subsequence converges for T_BTZ (GX.btzJ0_not_isCompact_diamond). The same configuration sits in a chart of M~ at every BTZ point, so M~ (T_BTZ) is not GH as soon as sing M is non-empty (argued; formalized in the model only). Consequently WP-41l's tagged transfer 'M GH => M~ GH' (GX.BTZTildeData.globallyHyperbolic_of_base) was false and is REMOVED; its counterexample instance M = {tau<0} subset E0 (GH, GX.e0PastHalf_globallyHyperbolic in the charted form) is argued, not formalized (its M~ is the corresponding part of J+(Delta_0)).

The lemma itself (l.2359) is TRUE and proved by a different route: the projection M~ -> M is causal (GX.BTZTildeData.proj_le; over reg M by IsRegDevelopingOnReg.eventually_eq_smul_chart, over sing M by the lifted charts and E0.Le being winding free), I+(x) = I+(y) forces D x = D y and p x = p y (J+ closed in Minkowski space and in the GH M), and a causal chain from y to a point z >> x near x stays over a causally convex V (strong causality of M) inside a sheet on which (p, D) is injective (evenly covered over reg M, the lifted chart over sing M).

theo:globally_hyperbolic_cauchy_complete_cauchy_maximal l.2390 'Since M~ is globally hyperbolic, it is future distinguishing': the premise is false with T_BTZ whenever sing M is non-empty (previous finding); the conclusion it is used for is GX.BTZTildeData.isFutureDistinguishing_of_base, which Uniformization's injective_D_of_isBTZFutureComplete already calls (now sorry-free).

kb_proposals: Causal.Causality.generated over an atlas (index = the atlas as a subtype, source opens chartSource, transported model causalities chartTransport) is the cheapest causality on a space with charts: ≪ is open for free, and a link unfolds by Causal.LocalCausality.extend_le_iff inf_le_right (GX.btzTildeAtlasCausality, GX.btzTilde_link_le_iff).

One model for regular and BTZ points of BTZ~-manifolds: GX.btzJ0RegIncl (J⁺(Δ₀)∖Δ₀ ↪ 𝕄 as OpenPartialHomeomorph) plus a translation turns every Minkowski chart into a chart into J⁺(Δ₀) (GX.exists_mem_btzTildeDevAtlas_of_chart).

WP-41d's glued tamifying topology on M~ is natural over reg M (hN none in its proof) but the exported theorem drops that clause; any chart at a regular point of (M~, T') needs it: use GX.btz_manifold_exists_chartwise_tamifying_reg.

A local variable of class type (t t' : TopologicalSpace α) is a local instance inside a def body: to read a partial homeomorphism for a second topology, wrap it (WrappedTop) and use a type synonym carrying it as instance (GX.WithWrappedTop, GX.OpenPartialHomeomorph.retopBTZ).

When a goal quantifies over a type synonym (WithWrappedTop T'), `intro (e : UnderlyingType)` fixes the local's type, otherwise membership/connectedComponentIn lemmas of the underlying type fail with 'synthesized instance not defeq'.

The causality of an E0-manifold in the SingularGXStructure form is GX.e0ManifoldCausality M hM (generated by regular a.e.-atlas charts into 𝕄 and def:atlas E0-charts into 𝔼₀, inside Y = 𝕄 ⊕ 𝔼₀ with E0LM.D); GX.chartAtlasCausality gives tarentin and Z⁺ for any atlas from LocTarentin/LocZplus of the model, no groupoid needed.

T_BTZ (the BTZ topology of J+(Delta)) is not locally compact at the BTZ line and its diamonds with a BTZ vertex are not compact: points of the null cone of a BTZ point p0 converging in Minkowski space to a later BTZ point x never enter I+(p) cup ]p,+inf[ for p between p0 and x (GX.btzJ0_not_isCompact_diamond). Never try to prove GH of a T_BTZ spacetime with BTZ points.

To compare the causality of M~ (charts into J+(Delta_0)) with that of M (charts into M + E0): prove local monotonicity of the projection in terms of D (D p <= D q => p p <= p q near each point) and integrate it along chart-link curves with Causal.CurveOn.rel_of_lt on the relation family (C.le top, membership in N); this avoids identifying the charts (GX.BTZTildeData.proj_localMono, proj_le_of_link).

E0.Le is winding free, so a Minkowski-causal pair of developments btzDevM 0 btzV0 of the cylinder projects to an E0.Le pair (GX.e0Le_of_btzDevM_le via GX.btzDevM_eq_lift); inside a causally convex set of E0 (E0.stronglyCausal) the relation is realised by E0.cle_of_seg + E0.le_seg_ends.

Future distinguishing without GH: Z+, D continuous and increasing give D x = D y from I+(x) = I+(y); the base projection and closed J+ of a GH base give p x = p y; strong causality of the base plus a sheet on which (p, D) is injective finish (GX.BTZTildeData.isFutureDistinguishing_of_base).

On d.Space = WithWrappedTop d.T', state lemmas through d.toNat / d.proj / d.dev (functions typed on d.Space) and ascribe connectedComponentIn sets explicitly to MaxBranchedCover: otherwise elaboration picks the T' instance and 'synthesized instance not defeq' errors appear.
